instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. In an indoor boxing gym with training gear and a whiteboard in the background, the male trainer in a gray t-shirt (R1) stands on the left, back to the camera, holding up a black focus mitt. The barefoot woman in a blue hoodie (R2) stands on the right on black mats in a boxing stance, throwing a left punch with her pink glove. The woman (R2) aims her punch directly at the mitt held by the trainer (R1). The scene is illuminated by even overhead gym lighting, showing natural colors and clear details.
